notes: Cross-verse split with 9:10 and 9:36, which give the whole *a certain* to the indefinite tis. Only Greek word order differed, which does not decide determiner attachment. The corpus reads *a certain* on tis in 17 units plus 2 of *a certain man*, and ACT.8.36 states the reasoning; ACT.10.1 reads it the other way and is the divided minority.
